title: Mall World’s goal = cold fusion
content: I found a huge dilapidated power generator outside the mall on the edge of a wooded area with a river running through it. Someone stopped by and said the goal was to create an unlimited power source to bring mall world back. All the houses around it once had employees of the power plant living there. I was moving into one of them and saw several old artifacts of previous tenants. It was very moldy in there though. I’m looking at the whole thing differently now.
